verdict.line: You win if you all-in on his Q cooldown before level 6 and bank a lead; you lose if the game drags to a level 16+ isolated 1v1 where his ult and magic pen finally outpace your HP stacking.

brief.thesis: Sett's passive Pit Grit fills off Mordekaiser's own poke, so every Q (Obliterate) he lands to harass you also loads your empowered auto and the heal that comes with it. Mordekaiser has zero disengage before level 6 — no dash, no slow he can use defensively — so an E (Facebreaker) stun into all-in during that window is close to free damage. After 6, R (Death Realm) flips the math: it isolates the fight to 1v1 and removes outside help, and his late-game magic penetration starts cutting through raw HP stacking faster than you can out-scale it.

theirWindow.when: he lands Q and you're grit-empty
theirWindow.what: Back off and let minions eat the follow-up autos — his passive (Darkness Rise) charges off damage dealt, so tanking a second Q or auto on top of the first spikes into real burst. Don't trade back until your Grit bar refills.

yourWindow.when: his Q just went on cooldown, pre-6
yourWindow.what: Walk up and E (Facebreaker) him into the wall or just for the stun, then dump W (Haymaker) and empowered autos. With Q down he has nothing but base autos and W (Indestructible) shield to answer, and that shield only scales off his missing health so it's weak while he's topped up.

powerCurve.note: Both just trading autos, no combo pieces yet
E unlocks all-in, he has no disengage
Death Realm isolates duels, big spike
Trades hinge on existing gold lead

start.why: The regen and damage reduction on first hit directly counters Q poke, and it pairs with Grit sustain so short trades cost you almost nothing.

boots.why: Morde's only CC is the E (Death's Grasp) pull — tenacity shortens how long you're locked in range, and the flat MR blunts his Q/passive magic burst all lane.

core.why: The bonus damage on Grit-empowered autos and the slow help you actually catch him once he tries to walk away post-trade.
Proc heal on crit stacks another layer of sustain on top of Grit, which is the whole reason this lane leans your way early.

core.item: Spirit Visage or Force of Nature
core.why: His passive and Q both hit as percent-max-health magic damage — flat HP stacking loses value fast, magic resist with healing/tenacity doesn't.

situational.when: their team adds a heavy crit or AD skirmisher alongside Morde
you need a free reset to win a drawn-out Death Realm duel late
their comp is otherwise AD-heavy and you need the grievous wounds

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks off the extended trades Grit already sets up, and the healing amp on full stacks compounds with your passive sustain instead of competing with it.

summoners.why: Ignite punishes his W (Indestructible) shield-based healing and turns your pre-6 all-in window into a kill instead of just a trade.

playing.title: Only trade near a full Grit bar
playing.detail: Check your passive meter before walking up — an empowered auto is most of your trade damage, and firing it into a still-loading bar just feeds his Darkness Rise charge for free.

playing.title: All-in before level 6, not after
playing.detail: Once he hits Death Realm, any skirmish can turn into a 1v1 with your jungler locked out. Force your fights in the level 3-5 window instead.

playing.title: Track his Q cooldown, not his HP
playing.detail: His HP bar lies because W (Indestructible) shields harder the lower he gets. His Q being down is the real green light to engage.

playing.title: Don't shove into his Q wave clear
playing.detail: Obliterate hits the whole wave in an AoE around him — pushing lets him clear for free and poke you at the same time. Let the wave meet mid unless you're ready to all-in.

playing.title: Save R for after his E lands
playing.detail: The Show Stopper stun lasts longer the further he's knocked, but he can't cancel your grab with anything — use it to guarantee the full W-Q-auto sequence, not as an opener.

playing.title: Post-6, fight near your jungler's path
playing.detail: Death Realm can only pull you two into the isolated realm, not a nearby ally physically — but it still removes peel and vision for your team, so don't skirmish in brush or off-angle spots where he can flip the fight before help arrives.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names here reflect the standard Sett top build as of my last training update (Jan 2026) — check the current in-client store and rune page for renames or reworked mythic-tier items before locking build order, since LoL itemization churns every few patches.
